grh_8bd784c1440ef96ba1a5.title: Spring Cleaning
paragraphs: While wealthy Mrs. Perry is away, longtime housekeeper Harriet is left to complete the spring cleaning under the eye of the woman's resentful daughter-in-law Darlene. Harriet's daughter Jane, a college student, is meanwhile involved with an older man she knows as Pete, who avoids meeting her family and speaks of a cottage where they can be alone. When Jane visits the Perry house with her mother, she discovers that Pete is actually Herb Perry, Darlene's married husband. Herb denies any real affair and claims Jane has built a fantasy around a few conversations, but details he shared with her make the explanation increasingly difficult to accept. Darlene cancels a dinner party and takes Herb home for a private reckoning. To protect herself from Mrs. Perry's criticism, she agrees not to report Harriet's drinking if Harriet says nothing about the scandal. The house is restored to order before Mrs. Perry returns, though the family's hidden problems remain.

[[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Cecily Tyson, [[person|virginia-gregg|Virginia Gregg]], Joan McCall, Steven Markle, and Irene Tedrow. Other credited names include Fletcher Markle as director, Fletcher Markle as producer, and Chris Fortunato as writer.
The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.9b0a0ccffce2f7d3|Sears, Roebuck and Company]].

grh_8be339657d3ca200a4d7.title: A Piece of Flesh
paragraphs: A television network searching for a ratings hit decides to revive the career of William Trevor, a once-famous actor who vanished from public life and has been destroyed by alcoholism. Producer Jan North tracks him from a skid-row hotel to a secluded ranch, where a doctor gets him through withdrawal while the network prepares makeup, contracts and a carefully staged comeback meeting. Trevor gradually recognizes that returning to stardom would mean rebuilding the same identity that helped trap him in the first place. When the network executive treats him as a commodity rather than a person, Trevor cancels the meeting and chooses the uncertain work of finding a new life instead.

grh_8b18e5cee95316b35df7.title: Take a Letter Darling
paragraphs: Advertising executive A.M. MacGregor hires artist Tom Verney as her male secretary, expecting him to provide the social charm that helps her handle conservative male clients. Tom resents being treated as a decorative employee, but the two become increasingly dependent on one another while wealthy Southern client Jonathan Caldwell complicates matters by courting Mac. Tom's outrageous parting gift finally blows up Mac's expected match with Caldwell, and when she realizes Tom is leaving for Mexico she abandons the business-first pose and admits she is in love with him.
